title: Portfolio redesign
brief: Full redesign of Fernando Uribe Trujillo's portfolio serving both employers/recruiters and local business clients (transport, agencies, Manzanillo businesses: CFDI 4.0, Carta Porte, digital records). Must keep a11y modes, ES/EN parity and scroll-driven reveal.

artboards.title: Dos puertas
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the dark/gold identity and routes each audience in the first screen; cases use one problem/what I did/result grid. Adds a choice up front and is the least surprising visually.

artboards.title: Expediente técnico
artboards.tradeoff: Light editorial case files with a sticky index and an Employer/Business reading switch; most credible depth for recruiters. Slowest to scan and drops the dark identity by default.

artboards.title: Demo primero
artboards.tradeoff: The hero is a working vehicle-inspection demo plus a bento of demos; shows instead of tells, strongest for clients. Heavier to build and maintain, and the person reads more like a product.
